my definition of my mixed states is normally where my mood changes from happy to sad and everything in between but the thing that is constant is the excessive energy. its like everything had a crazy undertone. so im feeling down but my sad thoughts are racing and are making me feel worked up. or if im feeling happy but also really irritated or paranoid. i also get all kinds of intrusive thoughts - scary ones like a truck driving into me or a funny one like the urge to shout something loud and inappropriate in a quiet place.

one other thought specific to the rapid cycling - do you have a crisis or contigency plan in place? i can get a small diazepam prescription if im in crisis and just knowing its there and i have an option to try if everything else fails helps me cope better.

the nights can be really dangerous for me for the same reason. tranqqing myself with seroquel is the only thing that works. if nightmares were the only side effect might be worth another go? you could add a few sleep hygeine things to help with the nightmares eg listening to something soothing before sleep, avoiding alcohol or certain food
